department: Department of Civil, Environmental and Geomatic Engineering (D-BAUG)

deadline.value: No deadline: professors recruit doctoral students throughout the year, so apply whenever a position is open.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for submitting the registration for the doctorate, as the professors recruit their candidates throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must find an ETH professor willing to supervise you and offer you a position before you can register; contact professors directly.
supervisor.quote: In order to be able to complete a doctorate at ETH, a professor at ETH must be willing to supervise your dissertation.

funding.value: Apart from a few exceptions, ETH doctoral students are employed (salaried) as scientific assistants.
funding.quote: Apart from a few exceptional cases, all doctoral students at ETH Zurich are employed as scientific assistants.

entry_route.value: A completed university Master's degree is required before you can register for the doctorate.
entry_route.quote: You must have a university Master's degree.

notes: D-BAUG gives no department-specific admission rules; it points to ETH's central doctorate pages and to its institutes' research topics.
